'''Evona's Heart''' was a legendary [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] from the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Evona/Legends|Evona]]. The [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] believed that their goddess cast her heart out into the void, and that the crystal felt on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Varl/Legends|Varl]].<ref name="LoNH" />
